name: Choir
overview: Scripture reveals the choir as a vital expression of worship, where singing praises to the Lord unites believers in joyful proclamation of His deeds and grace. From the morning stars singing together in Job 38:7 to the exhortation in Colossians 3:16 to teach and admonish through psalms and hymns, the choir serves both as a spiritual discipline and a communal act of worship. The role of choir directors and choirs is implied in the organized singing within congregations, emphasizing heartfelt grace and thanksgiving as seen in Psalms 105:1 and 149:1, and the encouragement to sing in times of joy as in James 5:13.
